front: Moment of a force about a point
back: Force $\times$ perpendicular distance from the point to the line of action; unit N m; has a sense (clockwise or anticlockwise).

front: Moment of $X\mathbf{i} + Y\mathbf{j}$ acting at $(x, y)$ about $O$
Conditions for equilibrium of a rigid body
back: Resultant force zero (resolve in two directions) AND total moment about any one point zero.

front: Weight of a uniform rod, beam or ladder
Reaction of a smooth wall or smooth peg
back: Perpendicular to the surface of contact (for a peg or rail: perpendicular to the rod).

front: Beam on the point of tilting about one support
back: The reaction at the other support is zero; take moments about the tilting support.
Unknown magnitude and direction: use components X and Y; take moments about the hinge to remove them.

front: Ladder of weight W on smooth wall, rough ground, limiting, angle θ with ground

back: About the point where the most unknown forces act; check with moments about a second point.
